profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack engineer with 10+ years of experience building web products, mostly at startups. React and TypeScript are home base for me, but I’m comfortable anywhere in the stack, from Java/Kotlin and Rails services to AWS.

For the last few years I’ve worked in healthcare and fintech. At Paytient I helped build our Medicare Prescription Payment Plan portals in eight months for a national launch, and that program now has the best repayment rate in the industry. Before that I worked on mortgage lending at Maxwell and led the shopping cart team at Sling TV.
I care about building things that actually make people’s lives easier, and about the details that get you there: accessibility, performance, and clean, well-tested code. I also love mentoring and helping teams move faster, lately by going all in on AI tools in how I work.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack software developer. Focused on front-end development for sling.com (AngularJS) and back-end development of a content-management system (Ruby on Rails).

Client: Sling TV

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: I work on a global team tasked with managing the stability, operation, and automation of more than 50 Bluemix environments (Cloud Foundry-based cloud platforms) for enterprise clients, as well as the industry’s largest public Cloud Foundry deployments.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered as a teaching assistant for Denver's RailsBridge, an organization that hosts free Ruby and Rails workshops for people who are underrepresented in the tech industry.

projects.title: Fantasy Phish
projects.description:
fantasyphish.com

A fantasy game for Phish fans. Pick 13 songs before each show, score points when they play your picks, and compete on the tour leaderboard.

projects.title: Gramcrackr
projects.description: App built in Ruby on Rails and Javascript that provides Instagram users the ability to see their liked images and save Instagram images, two features currently unavailable from the web.
